events.title: Noosa Alive! Festival
events.description: A multi-day arts and cultural festival across Noosa, featuring performances, exhibitions, and events in various venues, kicking off with a Queensland Ballet performance. Includes both ticketed and free community programs.

events.title: Open Studios Sunshine Coast
events.datetime: Fri 17 Jul - Sun 26 Jul, 10:00 AM - 4:00 PM daily
events.location: Various artist studios across Sunshine Coast
events.description: A chance to visit local artist studios across the Sunshine Coast hinterland and coastline, view their work, purchase directly from artists, and potentially participate in workshops.

events.title: Art in Nature - Sculpture Garden Guided Walk
events.description: A guided walk through a sculpture garden, exploring art integrated with nature.

events.title: Bli Bli Social Pickleball - Monday Evenings
events.source: Mooloolaba Pickleball Club, KT Academy Pickleball
events.description: A social pickleball session for community members, hosted by local pickleball clubs. A chance to play and socialize in a relaxed atmosphere.

events.title: Introduction to Mindfulness and Meditation
events.description: An introductory session to mindfulness and meditation techniques, suitable for beginners looking to learn practices for well-being.

events.title: Coffee & Chat Twin Waters
events.description: A casual coffee and chat social gathering for singles aged 60 and over, aimed at fostering connection and community.

events.title: Magic of Mooloolaba FitWalk
events.source: It's Fun It's Free - It's Lets Walk and Talk
events.description: A free, social fitness walk in Mooloolaba designed for conversation and light exercise, hosted by a community walking group.

events.title: Free Sahaja Yoga classes

events.description: Free Sahaja Yoga classes held weekly in Parrearra, offering meditation and mindfulness practices in a community setting.

events.title: Game Night - Max 6
events.description: An intimate board or card game night limited to six participants, hosted by a social group for professional women in Noosa aged 45-65.

events.title: Bli Bli Social Pickleball - Thursday Evenings
events.source: Mooloolaba Pickleball Club, KT Academy Pickleball
events.description: A social pickleball session for community members, hosted by local pickleball clubs. A chance to play and socialize in a relaxed atmosphere.

events.title: Great Walk (Stage 2) - Flaxton
events.description: The second stage of a great walk in Flaxton, organized by the Sunshine Coast Hiking Group, offering a chance for guided outdoor adventure and social interaction.

events.title: The In- Progress Table
events.description: A discussion-oriented meetup hosted by the "Trails, Tables & Talks Club" in Maroochydore, designed for engaging conversation.

events.title: Mudjimba to Pincushion Island Beach Walk/Lunch
events.description: A scenic beach walk from Mudjimba to Pincushion Island, followed by a social lunch, organized by a group focused on fun, fitness, and coffee.

events.title: Early Saturday Lunch
events.description: A social early Saturday lunch meetup for empty nester couples aged 45 and over, offering a relaxed environment for connection.

events.description: An outdoor walking event designed for tech professionals on the Sunshine Coast to network, share ideas, and connect in a casual, active setting.

events.title: Moffat Beach to Currimundi Lake 6.8km Coastal Path
events.source: Women's Walk And Talk - Sunshine Coast
events.description: A 6.8km social walk along the coastal path from Moffat Beach to Currimundi Lake, hosted by a women's walking and talking group.

events.title: Coastrek Sunshine Coast 2026
events.description: A team-based charity hiking event along the Sunshine Coastline, with 20km, 30km, and 50km options, raising funds for mental health initiatives through Beyond Blue.

events.title: Gratitude Walk and Fun Run
events.description: A community "gratitude walk" and fun run event, offering a social and active way to engage in physical activity.
